Cf3w4_ZLmx0.text: drlindaleemd Boston, Massachusetts Follow drlindaleemd 228w Early Necklift Recovery ✨ One of the most common questions patients ask is about the short term recovery following a Mini-Lift. Full healing can take a year, but you may be surprised how much you like your result, even only after 1 week! 👆 Here's what to expect: 1️⃣Mild bruising and pink around the incisions can be covered (strategic makeup and hairstyles), so many people return to work or casual social activities after 7-10 days. 2️⃣ Walking is encouraged from day 1 but heavy exercise should wait until 2 weeks post-op. 3️⃣Pain is generally well-controlled with over the counter medications. 4️⃣Since incisions can be hidden in the hair, it may be difficult to shampoo for a few days. The secret? Dry shampoo! Some additional tips that MAY help prevent bruising or bleeding: icing the face, wearing a compression dressing, eating pineapple, avoiding alcohol and salt. There is no question that every person's recovery is unique, but knowing general recovery can help with planning. maripili1985 20w Where Are You located Reply mel_mas88 23w How much does it cost?
